items.educational_guardrail: Set a monthly trading-frequency review threshold and compare outcomes after the month closes.
items.evidence_strength_reason: high activity is defined by the documented 75th percentile monthly trade-count rule
items.finding: High-activity months were compared with other eligible months without claiming causation.
items.limitation: Month-level aggregation cannot prove trading frequency caused outcomes.

items.educational_guardrail: Separate options-risk review from long-equity review before evaluating behavior.
items.evidence_strength_reason: compares asset-type aggregates without recalculating option multipliers
items.finding: Option and equity outcomes differed in the high-confidence completed-trade sample.
items.limitation: Options with basis transfers or unresolved lifecycle events are excluded.

items.educational_guardrail: Define an exit condition before entering a trade and review whether losers stay open longer.
items.evidence_strength_reason: winner and loser median holding periods are calculated from completed trades
items.finding: Losing-trade holding periods were compared with winning-trade holding periods using calendar days.
items.limitation: CSV exports lack intraday ordering, so same-day timing is not inferred.

items.educational_guardrail: Treat small-sample patterns as review prompts, not conclusions.
items.finding: Seven-day same-instrument re-entry analysis did not meet the minimum sample threshold.
items.limitation: Small samples are retained in supporting outputs but not promoted.

items.educational_guardrail: Review whether one loss can erase several typical gains before entering a trade.
items.evidence_strength_reason: largest-loss concentration is computed from opaque grouped high-confidence trades
items.finding: A small number of losses accounted for a measurable share of gross losses.
items.limitation: Excluded unknown-basis and unmatched records may hide additional losses.

items.educational_guardrail: Review realized outcomes separately from deposits, withdrawals, and unresolved records.
items.finding: High-confidence completed trades had net realized P&L of -803.
items.limitation: Analytical realized P&L is not tax P&L and excludes unresolved trades.

items.educational_guardrail: Use a cooling-off checklist before quickly re-entering the same instrument after a loss.
items.evidence_strength_reason: uses only sequence evidence by opaque instrument and calendar date
items.finding: The engine found completed trades opened after a prior loss in the same opaque instrument.
items.limitation: This does not infer intent, emotion, revenge trading, or averaging down.
